text.p: SAN RAFAEL, Calif., July 28 - MCB Financial Corp., parent company of Metro Commerce Bank, N.A. (Metro), Monday reported second quarter net income of $355,513, or $0.36 per share.
This compares to net income of $306,969, or $0.33 per share, for the second quarter of 1996.

For the six months ended June 30, 1997, net income was $602,443, or $0.61 per share, as compared to $1,322,595, or $1.40 per share, during the same period last year (which includes a pre-tax recovery of approximately $1.8 million in litigation expenses).
Excluding the litigation recovery, net income for the six months ended June 30, 1996, would have been approximately $450,000, or $0.48 per share.

MCBF's total assets increased to $142.2 million as of June 30, 1997, up from $126.2 million a year earlier. Total deposits increased to $129.3 million as of June 30, 1997, up from $114.0 million a year earlier. Total loans increased by
11.9 percent to $80.9 million, up from $72.3 million a year earlier.
